lean.statement:
theorem exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison_degree
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ≅
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n,
      IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison X F U W g n e

proof.text: Obtain the normalized comparison homomorphism in degree n. Apply the inverse theorem to that homomorphism and its normalization, obtaining both categorical inverse identities. Package the homomorphism and inverse as an isomorphism; its hom is definitionally the normalized homomorphism, so its normalization is exactly the target predicate.
